summary: The completed workflow passes T6, but the close oracle does not prove token secrecy in generated temporary artifacts.
verified: vloop task gate T6 exited 0: gate T6: pass (13.866s).
notes: The oracle scans command stdout and stderr in combined, but never inspects files in its temporary repository before os.RemoveAll(root). Acceptance 3 requires no output, log, fixture, or error to contain the stub token, so the gate needs an artifact scan (or a product-independent assertion over every generated artifact) before cleanup; the product was not changed to mask this test gap.

gate_dispute.reason: The gate can pass even if the workflow persists the stub token in a generated log, fixture, or configuration artifact.
gate_dispute.evidence: oracle.go appends only got.stdout and got.stderr to combined, checks strings.Contains(combined, "stub-token"), and then calls os.RemoveAll(root) through defer without reading or scanning the temporary repository's artifacts, although T6 acceptance 3 explicitly covers output, log, fixture, and error secrecy.
